newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-RAKVERE'S RIGAS MIESNIEKS TO GET NEW MANAGEMENT.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-RAKVERE'S RIGAS MIESNIEKS TO GET NEW MANAGEMENT.

text.p: Estonia's Rakvere said on Friday that its Latvian subsidiary Rigas Miesnieks, Latvia's largest meat producer, will on August 1 vote for a new management board.
"The meeting will choose new members for the board and council," Rakvere development director Andrus Mottus told Reuters. "Our goal is to gain control."
He added that Estonians would fill the key posts in the Latvian firm in a first stage of its development.
Rakvere bought 67 percent of shares in Rigas Miesnieks in May for 103 million kroons.
Mottus added that the management's task was to complete a strategy for the Latvian company, which it has already started.
